items.text: Dear guests,
Management has completed another round of discreet maintenance throughout Hotel Barcelona.

A few troublesome incidents in the corridors have been dealt with, our matchmaking services have received some much-needed attention, and several Catalan notices have been rewritten by someone with considerably better handwriting.
Adjusted Catalan localization text.
Fixed an issue where Zillion’s jump-bite grab attack could occasionally fail to result in the player’s death. Guests caught between those teeth should now meet the expected—and unfortunate—outcome.
Fixed an issue that caused frequent errors during Invasion multiplayer matchmaking under certain conditions.
Fixed an issue that prevented players from viewing the profiles of matched members.
Please enjoy the improved matchmaking—and remember: learning more about your fellow guests does not necessarily make them trustworthy.
From Osaka to wherever you are in the world!
— White Owls Inc.
Dear guests,
A message from the front desk.

Management has completed some light renovations, deep cleaning, wardrobe inspections, and the usual removal of unpleasant stains from the carpet. Patch 1.3.0 is now live, bringing new collaboration costumes, gameplay adjustments, quality-of-life improvements, and a few bug fixes for incidents that are best not discussed in the lobby.
Most importantly, the hotel closet has received several strange deliveries from some very special visitors.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033336/049b707fe4fbae834def6b52fba0a3e82c883039.png"]
Free Collaboration Costumes Have Arrived
As a thank you to everyone who has continued staying with us through the madness, Patch 1.3.0 adds new collaboration costumes in partnership with the following titles:
Shadows of the Damned
Bye Sweet Carole
Death Game Hotel
The Good Life
Please check your wardrobe before heading back into the nightmare. Some outfits may still smell faintly of gunpowder, roses, expensive hotel soap, or rural mystery.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033336/3341499487dede003de94575fe1097ec1d8be474.png"]
Gameplay Adjustments and Housekeeping
We have adjusted the time until timeout for each area in Newcomer difficulty.
The weather lottery screen before sortie has been changed. Guests can now also change the time of day, and in single-player mode, choose whether to accept invasions.
In single-player mode, PvP invasion acceptance is now set to OFF by default. Guests who enjoy unexpected visitors may still turn it back on.
Various rerolls and time-of-day changes are now performed directly using coins.
The design of dropped money has been adjusted.
Treasure chest drop pools in bonus stages have been changed, and the difficulty of obtaining outfits has been adjusted.
Gnome dolls have been placed in each stage. Break them to restore health. We are not responsible for what the gnomes may think of this arrangement.
The appearance of destructible objects has been adjusted.
Doors that cause Phantom Lost now have a dedicated indicator above them. Please read the signs before entering. Or do not. The hotel respects poor decisions.
A Slasher Phantom item has been added to the sound settings in the Options menu.
Fixes
Fixed an issue where behavior could become unstable if Scapegoats or Final Girl activated while the player was taking a grab attack.
Fixed an issue where behavior could become unstable when receiving a grab attack while in the Metallic player state.
Fixed an issue where the attack hitbox of flamethrower enemies could sometimes remain.
The elevators are still dangerous.
The rooms are still cursed.
But at least the wardrobe is looking better than ever.

Characters from Bye Sweet Carole appear courtesy of Little Sewing Machine and Maximum Entertainment France SAS. © 2025 Little Sewing Machine. Created by Chris Darril. Published and licensed by Maximum Entertainment France SAS. Developed by Little Sewing Machine, in collaboration with Meangrip Game Studios and Dreams Uncorporated. All rights reserved.
Dear Valued Guests,
Management is pleased to announce that a new maintenance and comfort update has now been deployed throughout the Hotel Barcelona premises.

Our staff have been working tirelessly behind the scenes to improve guest safety, stabilize paranormal disturbances, and ensure smoother survival conditions for all visitors currently trapped inside the facility.
Please review the latest property adjustments below.
GENERAL HOTEL ADJUSTMENTS
Expanded Storage Services
Storage balances have been adjusted so larger quantities of materials can now be safely stored while travelling toward mission objectives.
Jacob’s Special Move Renovation
Jacob’s special move has been reworked to ensure the final hit consistently connects. Damage and behavior have also been adjusted.
Atmospheric Enhancements
Additional visual effects have been installed across several interactive gimmicks and environmental objects throughout the hotel.
Chandelier Safety Improvements
Falling chandelier behavior has been adjusted to reduce unexpected guest incidents when stepped on.
DLC Ownership Indicator Added
An icon has been added to the Pause Menu and Title Screen so guests can confirm DLC ownership status.
EMERGENCY MAINTENANCE & BUG FIXES
Cutscene Repairs
Resolved an issue where boss door cutscenes during Stage 04 and Stage 05 could abruptly cut off midway through.
Grapple Attack Stability
Fixed an issue causing erratic character behavior after being struck by grapple attacks during specific player states.
Bomb Enemy Recovery
Corrected an issue where bomb enemies could continue running indefinitely after entering a Casino or Activity Zone.
Nigel Boss Encounter
Fixed a rare issue where the Nigel boss battle might fail to conclude correctly if the player was grabbed immediately before a timeout.
DLC Sound Effect Restoration
Corrected missing sound effects in DLC stages.
Reward Chances Tracking
Fixed an issue where kills performed with certain attack methods were not always counted correctly during Reward
Chances.
Stage 04 Interactive Objects
Resolved an issue where some interactive objects in Stage 04 would fail to drop money.
Ischemia Status Recovery
Fixed an issue where healing during the Ischemia status ailment could restore HP beyond the maximum limit.
Stamina Mechanic Correction
Resolved an issue where specific inputs allowed stamina-consuming attacks during a Stamina Break state.
Multiplayer Stage Selection
Fixed an issue in Multiplayer Stage Selection where the cursor could move into inaccessible areas on Kageromachi East Apt. Complex W-1 Bldg.
You may check out at any time.
But leaving alive remains unlikely.
— HOTEL BARCELONA MANAGEMENT
Patch 1.02.0 – Extended Stay, Extended Service
With the arrival of Late Check-Out, the hotel has undergone a series of renovations and adjustments. Some are for your comfort. Others… are not.
Gameplay & Balance Updates
Added new content and supporting elements alongside the DLC
Introduced new player statuses: Metallic, Spirit, and Spongy
Fewer environmental damage hazards
Simplified boss attack patterns for a smoother introduction
Professional and Slasher difficulties have been tuned up with stronger enemies
Player starting direction now better aligns with stage progression
Improved visibility on certain environmental hazards with new visual effects
Movement speed adjusted
Easier to follow up attacks after knocking them down
Tomatoes and piranhas now linger briefly off-screen before dying (instead of disappearing instantly)

items.text: Our maintenance team has been working overtime to ensure your stay at Hotel Barcelona runs… a little more smoothly. The elevators are (mostly) fixed, the wiring has been checked, and a few strange occurrences have been addressed.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where players could get stuck mid-air when using Stomp Kick on enemies below.
Fixed an issue where weapon enhancement levels could reset under specific conditions.
Fixed a bug where the “Free Version” achievement would not unlock correctly.
Fixed a co-op desynchronization issue during the Eve X boss fight.
Fixed an issue in the Jill boss fight where players could still receive the “No Damage” bonus after taking damage from falling into water.
Fixed unintended text display issues in Kageromachi East Apt. Complex W-1 Bldg. when opening the tutorial via keyboard.
Fixed an incorrect icon in the “Carnival Awakening Stock” guide when using keyboard controls.
Fixed the Activity Log scrollbar not functioning properly.
Fixed an issue where the Twin Buzzsaws Long-Range Attack could cause terrain clipping.
Fixed an issue where the Charge Smash sound effect did not loop correctly.
Fixed an issue where certain actions in the Closet menu could cause the game to become unresponsive.

The new management team at Hotel Barcelona remains committed to improving the guest experience. While our hotel may still be filled with slashers, supernatural events, and questionable safety standards, we are continuing renovations with one goal in mind:
A respectable four-star rating!
Thank you to everyone playing the updated Under New Management version and sharing feedback. Today’s patch includes the following fixes:
Fixes
Fixed an issue where the display priority order of the action tutorial was incorrect when attempting to skip the Prologue stage.
Fixed an issue where unnecessary water splash effects could appear during stage progression.
Fixed an issue where the achievement “Fashion Leader” could be unlocked without meeting the required conditions.
Fixed an issue where effect animations would stop when certain effects appeared at the edge of the screen.
Fixed an issue where some UI elements did not support mouse input.
Fixed an issue where unintended functions were assigned to certain keys during stage progression.
Fixed an issue where Slasher Phantom records for the Final stage were not correctly reflected after clearing the ESCAPE stage.
As always, thank you for staying with us at Hotel Barcelona.
And if you enjoy your stay… please consider leaving a review. Our staff are working very hard to earn that fourth star.
Dear guests,

A discreet refinement has been made to the hotel this evening. No chandeliers have fallen, no corridors have shifted (not that we are aware of; again, apologies to our guests on the 5th floor for last week’s tomfoolery). But a few curious snags have been properly seen to.
Fixed an issue where players were able to control their character during the fade-to-black screen after selecting "Retry Boss" on the Game Over screen.
Fixed an issue where the pause screen would occasionally remain darkened after performing specific inputs while paused.
Fixed an issue during the Ayako boss fight where heavy attacks would deal damage even if the attack was registered as a miss.
As always, we thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your continued stay.
From Osaka to wherever you are in the world!
White Owls Inc.
Dear guests,
Added DUALSHOCK to the list of supported controllers.
Fixed an issue where the Slasher Phantom’s outfit was locked to the default costume.
Fixed multiple issues related to the Catalan localisation.
While I have your attention, I would also like to remind you of our ongoing voting period for “Indie Games You Want to See Animated”
Vote for HOTEL BARCELONA here!
From Osaka to wherever you are in the world!
White Owls Inc.
Dear guests,
I have heard whisperings from the staff that one of our guests, esteemed social influencer Eve, has been requesting a few changes to benefit her stay here. Small fixes, big effects.
Added a new autoplay feature to dialogue windows.
Fixed an issue in the Eve boss fight where certain actions would not trigger.
Fixed an issue in the Eve boss fight where Eve’s armour gauge was not displayed correctly when transitioning to her second form.
Fixed a layout issue affecting some Spanish text when the text size was set to “Large”.
From Osaka to wherever you are in the world!
White Owls Inc.
Dear guests,
A small update has just been rolled out across the hotel. Nothing flashy. No fireworks in the lobby. Just a few things tightened, fixed, and quietly put back where they belong.
Updated the tutorial content in the Prologue stage, as well as adjusting the Prologue stage layout and UI.
Updated the activation animations for all Carnival Awakening abilities.
Optimised processing performance across the entire game.
Fixed an issue where the Ally achievement could not be unlocked.
Fixed an issue where changing the display language while mob NPC dialogue was shown would cause a temporary performance degradation.
Fixed an issue where obtaining a weapon as a Special Request reward would not unlock the corresponding journal entry.
Fixed an issue where the Nameless Witch’s magic projectile attacks could sometimes remain stuck to the ground.
Fixed multiple UI-related issues.

notes.title: A Note on the Preview Branch

items.text: Please accept our apologies, but residents currently in the Preview Branch will not see this update. We are still gathering feedback (please respond here), and will continue to do so until January the 5th, 2026.
From Osaka to wherever you are in the world!
White Owls Inc.
Dear guests,
We would like to advise that the swimming pool does not have a biomechanically engineered shark residing in its depths, and it is in fact safe to swim.
Adjusted the size of the boats placed on the water surface in the Prologue stage and Stage 01.
Adjusted the sinking speed of certain objects that submerge when the player stands on them.
Fixed an issue in the Journal where some UI elements were not displayed correctly.
Fixed an issue where switching languages while a mob NPC’s dialogue was displayed could cause performance drops.
Fixed an issue in Invasion Multiplayer where the player might stop falling after performing an Armor Break in mid-air.
Fixed an issue where falling into a pit while performing a Hold Attack on a sinking platform could cause the player to respawn on the sunken platform.
Fixed an issue where the player temporarily could not perform a water-surface jump after respawning from a pitfall.
Fixed an issue where the player might temporarily be unable to dodge after respawning from a pitfall.
Fixed an issue during the fight with Jacob where frontal melee attacks could temporarily fail to hit him.
Fixed an issue where stamina could continue to decrease when taking damage while guarding, even though the Special Request “Guard Disabled” was active.
Fixed an issue where the controller vibration setting would revert to enabled after restarting the game, even if Controller Vibration was turned off in the options.
Fixed an issue in the Journal where some UI elements were not displayed correctly.
From Osaka to wherever you are in the world!
White Owls Inc.
Welcome back, guests.

We’re currently experiencing structural… updates. Nothing to worry about. Most affected areas have been cleaned, the killer tomatoes have been re-crated, and four bugs pests were safely removed from your room.
If you require further information, please contact reception.
Added a guide UI on the World Map to help players start Multiplayer.
Updated the ranged weapon reward from Special Requests to a unique version that does not overlap with weapons sold in the shop.
Fixed an issue where the refund description shown when canceling Multiplayer and returning to Single Play was incorrect.
Fixed an issue where disconnecting during Invasion Multiplayer could prevent the game from properly transitioning to the results screen.
Fixed an issue where Slasher Phantom’s ranged attacks did not properly grant Blood Splatter when hitting enemies.
Fixed various issues related to text display and localization.
From Osaka to wherever you are in the world!
White Owls Inc.
Hello everyone,
A quick update following our previous message.
We said we would take action on the AI-related elements in the VHS tapes, and that work is now complete.
The 'Red Tree Entertainment' logo has been reimagined by our in-house artist, Nanna.
Voice-overs have been re-recorded, edited (thanks Randy!) and developed in collaboration with White Owls Inc.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033336/70548b4012ba60b097354304f0edc73f4b00a13e.png"]
The store page remains updated with clear disclosure, and we will continue to maintain those standards going forward.

Thank you again to everyone who raised it constructively and gave us the opportunity to fix it. We’ll keep you posted on the upcoming performance and QOL improvements as soon as they’re ready. There may be one or two incoming, but you didn't hear it from us.
Until then, stay slay,
CULT Games
REWIND <<
You are expecting the familiar.
Instead, it's changed.
The last contaminated frame buckles, peels, and vanishes, cut clean out of reality.
When the machine finally stops coughing up static, what remains is raw, unnerving analogue wearing a digital skin. A ghost in the circuitry, humming in the silence.
The VHS section of the game has been updated with a new 'Red Tree' logo and replaced voice overs by some awesome actors straight out of our little black book.
From London to wherever you are in the world!
CULT Games
PLAY ▶
Static. A face flickers. Someone whispers: “They updated it again.”
The price of the invasion prevention item “Dreamcatcher” has been reduced.
The price of the weather re-roll item “Old Weather Chart” has been reduced.
Doppelgängers can no longer invade in boss areas.
The money previously required for co-op multiplayer has been removed.
When invaded by a Doppelgänger while Special Requests are active, the Special Requests will now be temporarily disabled.
Optimized certain processes to slightly reduce the game’s processing load.
Added 800×450 and 1024×576 resolution options to the “Resolution” settings in the Options menu.
Fixed an issue where some enemy damage reactions were incorrect.
Fixed an issue where the player could become unresponsive after returning to their room from co-op multiplayer.
Fixed an issue where unnecessary character models could appear after returning to the room following a victory in invasion multiplayer.
Fixed an issue where Justine’s model could sometimes become invisible during certain cutscenes.
Fixed an issue where repeatedly pressing buttons during the weapon enhancement mini game in the casino could cause the player to become unresponsive.
Fixed multiple UI-related bugs.
Fixed multiple text display and localization-related issues.
From Osaka to wherever you are in the world!
White Owls Inc.
Greetings once again, esteemed guests -
Another patch is live. More bugs squashed. More polish applied. The hotel runs a little smoother tonight.
Added an option to limit the frame rate to 60 FPS in the Video Settings menu.
Adjusted the layout of the “Display HP Gauge Overhead” options in the Game Settings menu.
Fixed an issue where players could continuously gain boosts from continuous play bonuses beyond the intended limit when repeatedly looping through Stages 1 - 3.
Fixed an issue where the Reward Mission “Defeat 3 enemies at once” would not be marked as complete when achieved using a shotgun.
Fixed an issue where interacting with the mirror while the Final Stage was unlocked could cause the player to become uncontrollable.
Fixed an issue where interacting with a duct during multiplayer sessions could cause players to get stuck inside.
Adjusted input polling to match the monitor’s refresh rate.
Mitigated an issue where input detection could drop when the frame rate decreased.
Fixed an issue where the screen could freeze briefly at the start of a boss fight if a Slasher Phantom was present in the boss area.

Fixed an issue where, if the game was launched and settings were saved while using a monitor resolution below 1280×720, the Video Options would no longer function correctly and resolution changes would become unavailable when restarting the game with a resolution of 1280×720 or higher.
Fixed several bugs related to text display and localization.
From Osaka to wherever you are in the world!
White Owls Inc.
Greetings, esteemed guests -
We've just rolled out our first patch to make several gameplay improvements and bug fixes in HOTEL BARCELONA. Please find the details below!
Adjusted so that input is now registered when pressing the attack button while the player starts running or comes to a stop, as previously some frames did not accept input.
Adjusted so that input is now registered when pressing the attack button upon landing, as previously some frames did not accept input.
Adjusted so that input is now registered when pressing the dodge button in the movement direction upon landing, as previously some frames did not accept input.
Fixed an issue where the Twin Saw combos 'Fury Bash' and 'Fury Ascend' could not be executed until 'Psycho Slash' was unlocked.
Fixed an issue in Pinball where unintended functions were assigned to specific keys.
Fixed an issue where unlocking the skill 'Weapon Enhancement Luck Boost' did not increase the number of success cards.
Fixed an issue where the in-game button operation descriptions for Long-Range Attack and Knockback Attack were incorrect.
Fixed an issue in the Reward Chance 'Defeat 5 enemies using only ranged weapons' where kills with thrown weapons were not counted.
Fixed an issue where some aerial attacks with 'Scalpel and Staff' did not play sound effects.
Fixed an issue where, after returning to the title screen and resuming following stage information selection, the time period would revert to the previous one.
Fixed an issue where, after continuously playing from Stage 1 to 3 and then returning to Stage 1, Casino and Bonus doors would sometimes not appear.
Fixed an issue where, if the host failed in the Bonus Stage during multiplayer, the sync waiting screen was not displayed correctly on participant screens.
Fixed an issue where, after disabling the overhead health gauge in options and restarting the game, the gauge would still be displayed.
Fixed an issue where controller input would become unresponsive when checking other users' information in the multiplayer lobby.
Fixed an issue where, if a participant performed Armor Break at the same time the host died in multiplayer, the overhead icon would not disappear.
Fixed an issue where, after being defeated by a Doppelganger, the result screen dialog would not close, preventing progression.
Fixed an issue where some effects were not displayed correctly during certain demos.
Fixed several bugs related to UI display and effects.
Fixed several bugs related to HUD display.
Fixed several bugs related to text display and localization.
We're continuing to prepare an update that removes AI-assisted elements from the game's VHS segment. Once this is prepared, there will be no AI content in HOTEL BARCELONA whatsoever.
From Osaka to all of YOU around the world!
White Owls Inc

items.text: HOTEL BARCELONA's Steam Next Fest demo is OUT NOW. June 9 - 16.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2286600/HOTEL_BARCELONA/"]

Beat boss Jacob in the Next Fest demo and be in with the chance of winning a custom HOTEL BARCELONA varsity jacket signed by SWERY and SUDA51. Screenshot your victory and send it to us with the hashtag #BeatBossJacob. Hell yeah.
We announced the competition yesterday and some of you have managed to slaughter Jacob already...?! HOLY SH*T. Hats off, you sadomasochists!!!

Already entered? FYI: We're updating the method to enter the competition. Chalk it down to monsters eating your screenshots (we should've expected nothing less from the Hotel Barcelona's usual clientele) but annoyingly we can't see all of your entries and yeah, it's weird. As such, HERE'S THE UPDATED METHOD TO ENTER THE COMPETITION:
Play the demo on Steam between June 9 – 16
Defeat Jacob, the first boss
Take a screenshot proving your win
Post it in the official Steam Community Hub Discussion page with a link to your screenshot and/or social media
Add the hashtag #BeatBossJacob
Done. You’re entered.
We'll draw a winner at random from valid entries after the demo closes.
Custom HOTEL BARCELONA varsity jacket
Signed by SWERY and SUDA51
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/4z4FwVb.jpeg"]
Must be 18+ to enter
Open to United Kingdom, European Union (excluding Italy), Japan, United States, and Canada (excluding Quebec)
One entry per person
Winners announced June 21
Full terms: https://thecultgames.prezly.com/hotel-barcelona
Valve/Steam is not involved in this contest. We’re just using this space to feel the burn together.
This ain't a game for the weak hearted, but the Steam forums are fair game for sharing tips and tactics. Just don’t fake your screenshot - we will check. And Jacob will find you.
We can't wait to see who survives.
Now go die trying.
